title: Add bidirectional instruction-to-evidence traceability gate
outOfScope: Rewriting immutable archived Work Item Contracts or Summaries.
Automatically inferring missing requirements from natural-language prose without a declared traceability record.
Changing release behavior, version metadata, or unresolved remediation Work Items.

sources.reason: This Contract defines the governed implementation boundary and acceptance evidence.
Repository workflow requires explicit scope, acceptance, verification, Summary evidence, PR lifecycle, and fail-closed closure.
The remediation plan is the plan-side source that must be checked against implementation and acceptance evidence.
Existing Contract validation conventions are reused rather than creating an unconnected governance path.

riskAssessment.reason: A false pass would allow an explicit user requirement to disappear between the plan and implementation; the gate therefore fails closed on missing mappings and missing evidence. Natural-language inference is an explicit out-of-scope limitation, not an open unknown.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized establishing the bidirectional traceability mechanism; implementation remains limited to deterministic repository checks.

preReviewWarnings: Review that the gate proves declared mappings and evidence without claiming semantic natural-language completeness.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A versioned traceability record assigns every remediation-plan instruction a stable ID, plan Work Item, Contract path, implementation evidence, acceptance evidence, and verification command.

The deterministic checker fails closed when an instruction is unmapped, a mapped Contract is missing, a required named path is absent from implementation evidence without an explicit no-change rationale, or acceptance/verification evidence is missing.
The checker includes a regression case for the WI-10 installation-document omission that failed the prior audit.
The checker is exposed through a Make target and covered by focused tests, including pass, missing mapping, missing evidence, and explicit no-change rationale cases.
Documentation explains the forward and reverse traceability workflow and its limitation: structured declarations are checked; prose is not magically or completely inferred.
The remediation plan records this corrective Work Item and its verification evidence; all required AI and project checks pass and the complete PR/merge/ai-close/branch-cleanup lifecycle is completed.
guidelines: Keep governance checks deterministic and fail closed.
Preserve immutable archived historical evidence; use addenda or plan records for corrections.
Do not encode repository-specific facts in generic installed-template behavior unless the Contract declares them.

intent.problem: Detailed user instructions and later corrections can be present in conversation and a written plan while a specifically named existing file or acceptance requirement is omitted from the implementation. The prior WI-10 audit demonstrated that one-way plan execution did not reliably preserve instruction coverage.
constraints: Use a stable, reviewable, repository-local structured record rather than pretending a script can perfectly understand arbitrary natural language.
Keep archived historical Work Items immutable.
Require one Work Item, one dedicated branch, one PR, merge, ai-close, and branch cleanup for this correction.
Do not unblock or publish a release as part of this Work Item.
intent.rationale: A bidirectional deterministic gate makes omissions visible before implementation and before release: instructions must point to plan and evidence, while declared plan obligations must point back to implementation, acceptance, and verification.

rawUserRequest: 接受建议：建立“指示—计划—实现—验收”的双向追踪机制，防止执行计划遗漏用户指示；继续按完整 Work Item、PR、合并、ai-close-work-item、分支清理流程执行。发布前保持冻结。

declaredIntent.summary: Prevent explicit instructions and named deliverables from disappearing between user request, remediation plan, implementation, acceptance, and verification.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: WI-10 named installation path is omitted from implementation evidence.
A declared no-change rationale is present for a named path.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized establishing and implementing the bidirectional instruction-plan-implementation-acceptance traceability mechanism, including its Make gate.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
